categories.main_business_segments: Yihai Kerry Arawana Holdings Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main business segments: kitchen foods and feed raw materials & oil technology products. The kitchen foods segment includes edible oils, rice, flour, noodles, seasonings, eggs, grains, central kitchen products, and food industrial products. The feed raw materials and oil technology segment covers soybean meal, bran, rice bran meal, and oil-based chemical products, nutritional products, and daily chemical products derived from palm oil and other oils.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced processing technologies including oilseed pressing, oil refining, oil filling, specialized oils, oil technology, and deep processing of agricultural products like rice, corn, wheat, and soybeans. It utilizes a comprehensive industrial chain with integrated production bases (enterprise clusters) to maximize efficiency and scale economies. The company also emphasizes technological innovation in product development, including plant protein functional nutrition, seasoning quality improvement, low glycemic index flour and noodle products, and fermentation feed raw materials with microbial technology. Digitalization and smart factory initiatives are actively pursued to enhance production quality and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a wide range of customers including retail consumers, catering businesses, food industrial enterprises, and daily chemical product users. Key customers include chain supermarkets, hotel groups, restaurant chains, and food processing companies. The products cater to household, catering, and industrial kitchen food markets, as well as feed raw material markets primarily for pig and poultry farming. The company also targets health-conscious consumers with its diversified and functional food products.
categories.geographic_coverage: Yihai Kerry operates predominantly within China, with 97.23% of revenue generated domestically and 2.77% from overseas markets. It has a nationwide production and marketing network with multiple production bases strategically located near raw material sources, ports, railways, and end markets across various provinces including Shanghai, Jiangsu, Guangdong, Heilongjiang, and others. The company also has overseas subsidiaries and investments, with some operations and trade activities in Singapore and other countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the agricultural and food supply chain. It engages in oilseed pressing, oil refining, food processing, and production of feed raw materials and oil technology products. It integrates upstream raw material procurement with downstream product manufacturing and distribution, leveraging a vertically integrated industrial chain to control costs and quality.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the national strategic layout, enhancing production network efficiency through enterprise clusters, and deepening product diversification especially in health and functional foods. The company invests in R&D focusing on plant protein innovation, seasoning quality, low glycemic index products, and fermentation feed raw materials. It emphasizes digital transformation, smart factory development, and sustainable low-carbon operations aligned with national carbon neutrality goals. Talent development and channel integration are also key strategic areas.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue mainly through product sales of kitchen foods, feed raw materials, and oil technology products. Sales are conducted via direct sales and distribution channels, including retail, catering, and food industrial sectors. The company also earns investment income from financial assets and equity investments. Derivative financial instruments are used for hedging commodity price and foreign exchange risks, with related gains and losses reflected in investment income or cost of goods sold.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yihai Kerry is a leading player in China's edible oil and grain processing industry, holding top brand positions in edible oil, rice, and flour markets. It competes with other major domestic and international food processing companies. The company leverages its strong brand portfolio, extensive distribution network, integrated supply chain, and R&D capabilities to maintain market leadership. Its brands like 'Golden Dragon Fish' have been recognized as the top edible oil brand in China for fourteen consecutive years.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 238.87 billion, a 5.03% decrease from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 2.5 billion, down 12.14%. Despite revenue decline due to lower product prices, profit growth was supported by improved efficiency and product mix. The company has a total asset base of RMB 225 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 93.7 billion, reflecting a large-scale enterprise with stable growth and ongoing investments in capacity expansion and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yihai Kerry emphasizes providing nutritious, healthy, safe, and high-quality grain and oil products with a diversified product portfolio covering multiple price segments. Its competitive advantages include a comprehensive brand matrix, integrated industrial chain, advanced technology and R&D capabilities, and a nationwide efficient production and distribution network. The company focuses on innovation in health-oriented and functional foods, sustainable development, and digital transformation to meet evolving consumer demands and maintain market leadership.
